create_runtime_endpoint: create a RuntimeEndpoint to connect to an SGLang server via HTTP with base URL and optional API key
launch_runtime_server: launch a Runtime server process that starts an SGLang HTTP server and returns a client endpoint
generate_text_completion: generate a text completion from an SGLang backend using a StreamExecutor and sampling parameters
generate_streaming_response: generate a streaming response from an SGLang backend with incremental token chunks
select_best_completion: select the best completion from a list of choices using normalized prompt logprobs
encode_prompts: encode prompts into token IDs via the Runtime encode endpoint
cache_prefix_text: cache a prefix string on the SGLang server to reuse it for subsequent completions
concatenate_and_append: concatenate and append source request IDs to a destination request ID on the server
